title: MCTS-guided Bayesian optimization co-designs epoxy formulation and curing protocol
summary: A hierarchical Monte Carlo tree search-guided Bayesian optimization framework searched epoxy composition and curing protocols. With 30 experiments over four rounds it produced an epoxy resin meeting all four target property thresholds, which no initial sample, equal-weight baseline, or commercial or literature system achieved. Interpretable machine learning with targeted experiments indicated composition variables dominate property trends.
ai_technology: Hierarchical Monte Carlo tree search-guided Bayesian optimization with interpretable machine learning
organization: East China University of Science and Technology
